observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment retirement authority and Git adapter

outcome.implementation_change: Retirement eligibility now derives from writable repository rights and an exact branch, registered-worktree, or metadata-prune operation. It does not require a persistent claim; the existing adapter retains target-state, applicable live-claim, Git conditional-update, and worktree-removal checks. General delete remains separately escalation-gated.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: exact-policy-and-adapter-path-verified; later agent-intervention reduction not assessed
outcome.interpretation_limit: The tests and live dry-run establish an admitted and assessed operation. They do not establish a successful destructive retirement, cross-session recurrence reduction, or that all authority friction shares this cause.
